name: morph-ppt-3d
title_zh: GLB 模型直接进 PPT，镜头语言替你做转场
tagline_zh: 别人还在贴静态截图，你已经把 3D 模型搬进幻灯片，镜头推拉摇移跟着讲解走。不写一行动画代码。
tagline_en: While others paste static screenshots, you drop real GLB models into slides with camera moves that follow your.
desc_en: 3D Morph PPT — extends morph-ppt with GLB model insertion, cinematographic camera, model-content layout, and enriched visual design system.
why_zh: 把 3D 模型当成版式里的活元素，不是贴图。镜头路径由内容结构驱动，改讲解顺序，转场逻辑跟着变。
why_en: Treats GLB models as live layout elements, not decals. Camera paths derive from content structure—reorder your talk and.
limit_zh: 只认 GLB 格式，不认 FBX/OBJ；模型需自带 PBR 材质，否则渲染发灰。镜头只做推拉摇移和环绕。
limit_en: GLB only—no FBX/OBJ. Models need embedded PBR materials or they render flat. Camera limited to dolly/pedestal/orbit, no keyframed paths. Output is.
title_en: Drop GLB models into PPT with cinematic camera moves
